title: Implement section renderer component (shared between admin and exports)
description: Implement the SectionRenderer component in src/components/shared/SectionRenderer.tsx. This maps a SiteSection (type + variant) to the correct React component from a registry and renders it with the correct content and business props. This is the single rendering engine used by both the admin preview and exported sites.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts `{ section: SiteSection, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Maps all 21 section types + their variants to the correct component
Returns null for unknown type/variant combinations (no crash)
A `SiteRenderer` component iterates all visible sections and renders each
Both components work without errors for all section types

steps.description: Verify all section types are registered
steps.details: Check that COMPONENT_MAP has entries for all 21 section types. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to confirm no TypeScript errors. Navigate to a preview page and confirm the site renders without console errors.

technicalNotes: The COMPONENT_MAP is the single source of truth for which variants are available for each section type. The AI pipeline and edit UI both use this to know valid variant options.
When a section has `visible: false`, SiteRenderer skips it — this powers the section toggle in the edit UI.
This file is shared between the admin preview and exported sites.
